rule.R0: Profitability floor: keep a well while it covers its own upkeep
rule.R1: Injection allocation: water flows where it turns into oil
rule.R2: Offtake level: push clean wells, choke watered ones
rule.R3: Hysteresis: shut after months of loss, reopen only with margin
rule.R4: ESP threshold: do not cross a pump size boundary without payback
rule.R5: Compensation: keep group compensation inside the corridor
rule.R6: Conversion to injection: convert when injector beats producer
rule.R7: Cycling: periodically shut heavily watered wells
